batch: 3 (chs 11-17, the broken covenant, the confessions, the deceitful heart, the two trusts)

units.characteristics: the broken covenant; the innocent lamb unaware; committing the cause to the heart-testing God
units.gist: the broken covenant ('walked in the stubbornness of his evil heart'); the plot against Jeremiah at Anathoth - CONFESSION 1: 'I was like a GENTLE LAMB led to the slaughter; I did not know it was against me they devised schemes'; 'O LORD who judges righteously, WHO TESTS THE HEART AND THE MIND... TO YOU I HAVE COMMITTED MY CAUSE' - the wronged innocent entrusting his vindication to the God who reads hearts

units.characteristics: the complaint of the prospering wicked; near in the mouth, far from the heart; the toughening answer; God's own grief
units.gist: CONFESSION 2 - 'Righteous are you, O LORD, yet I would plead my case: WHY DOES THE WAY OF THE WICKED PROSPER?'; 'you are NEAR IN THEIR MOUTH and FAR FROM THEIR HEART'; God's answer 'if you have raced with men on foot and they wearied you, HOW WILL YOU COMPETE WITH HORSES?' (the summons to be toughened); God's own grief 'I have forsaken my house... THE BELOVED OF MY SOUL'; 'no man LAYS IT TO HEART'

units.characteristics: made to cling to God; pride spoiling; the leopard's spots / habituated evil
units.gist: GEM - the linen loincloth (worn close, then spoiled) - 'as the loincloth CLINGS to the waist, so I made Israel CLING TO ME, that they might be for me a people, a name, a praise, and a glory, BUT THEY WOULD NOT LISTEN'; 'I will SPOIL THE PRIDE of Judah'; 'my SOUL WILL WEEP IN SECRET for your pride'; 'can the ETHIOPIAN change his skin or the LEOPARD his spots? then also you can do good who are ACCUSTOMED TO DO EVIL' - intimacy intended, refused; habituated evil that cannot self-reform

units.characteristics: hope set on God amid deserved judgment; 'do not leave us'; the prophet's tears
units.gist: the drought; the people's prayer 'though our iniquities testify against us, ACT for your name's sake... O HOPE OF ISRAEL, its savior in time of trouble, why should you be like a STRANGER in the land?... yet YOU ARE IN THE MIDST OF US... DO NOT LEAVE US'; the false prophets of peace; the prophet's tears 'let my eyes RUN DOWN WITH TEARS night and day'; 'we ACKNOWLEDGE our wickedness... we set our HOPE ON YOU, for you do all these things'

units.characteristics: eating God's words as delight; the isolation of the calling; the raw complaint; the prophet called to return
units.gist: CONFESSION 3 - 'WOE IS ME, my mother, that you bore me, a man of strife'; 'your words were found, and I ATE THEM, and your words became to me A JOY AND THE DELIGHT OF MY HEART'; 'I SAT ALONE, because your hand was upon me'; the raw accusation 'will you be to me like a DECEITFUL BROOK, like waters that FAIL?'; God's answer 'IF YOU RETURN, I will restore you... you shall be AS MY MOUTH' (the prophet himself called to repent); 'I am with you to save you'

units.characteristics: the costly sign-bearing life; God as strength, stronghold, refuge
units.gist: Jeremiah forbidden to marry, to mourn, to feast - his whole life made a SIGN of the coming desolation (the costly vocation, its personal renunciations); 'you have done worse than your fathers, every one follows his STUBBORN, EVIL WILL'; then the confession of trust 'O LORD, MY STRENGTH and my STRONGHOLD, my REFUGE in the day of trouble... our fathers have inherited nothing but LIES... can man make for himself gods?'

units.characteristics: the two trusts (cursed shrub / blessed tree); the deceitful heart searched by God; heal me
units.gist: THE GEMS - 'the sin of Judah is ENGRAVED on the tablet of their heart'; 'CURSED is the man who TRUSTS IN MAN and makes flesh his strength... he is like a SHRUB in the desert'; 'BLESSED is the man who TRUSTS IN THE LORD... he is like a TREE PLANTED BY WATER... does not fear when heat comes, not anxious in the year of drought'; 'THE HEART IS DECEITFUL ABOVE ALL THINGS, and desperately sick; who can understand it? I THE LORD SEARCH THE HEART'; 'the FOUNTAIN OF LIVING WATER'; 'HEAL ME, O LORD, and I shall be healed'
